title: Earthy Korean Beef Grill
description: Savory, chewy, and flavorful, this weeknight Korean dish is perfect for a quick and easy meal. It's keto-friendly and features the unique flavor of soda water.

ingredients.name: Flank Steak
ingredients.notes: Choose a high-quality beef with good marbling for the best flavor.

ingredients.name: Gochujang
ingredients.notes: Look for a gochujang that's low in added sugars.

ingredients.name: Soy Sauce
ingredients.notes: Use a gluten-free soy sauce to keep the dish keto-friendly.

ingredients.name: Brown Sugar
ingredients.notes: A small amount of brown sugar helps balance out the flavors.

ingredients.name: Soda Water
ingredients.notes: The carbonation in soda water helps tenderize the beef.

ingredients.name: Ginger
ingredients.notes: Fresh ginger adds a spicy kick to the dish.

ingredients.name: Garlic
ingredients.notes: Mince the garlic to release its flavors.

ingredients.name: Green Onions
ingredients.notes: Use green onions for added flavor and texture.

ingredients.name: Sesame Oil
ingredients.notes: A small amount of sesame oil adds a nutty flavor to the dish.

ingredients.name: Toasted Sesame Seeds
ingredients.notes: Toasted sesame seeds add a crunchy texture to the dish.

ingredients.name: Rendered Beef Fat
ingredients.notes: Use rendered beef fat to keep the dish keto-friendly and add flavor.

ingredients.name: Korean Chili Flakes
ingredients.notes: Use Korean chili flakes for a spicy kick.

ingredients.name: Black Pepper
ingredients.notes: Use freshly ground black pepper for the best flavor.

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.notes: Use kosher salt to add flavor to the dish.

ingredients.name: Cooked Rice
ingredients.notes: Serve with cooked rice for a filling meal.

instructions: Preheat a robata grill to medium-high heat.
Season the flank steak with salt and black pepper.
In a small bowl, whisk together gochujang, soy sauce, brown sugar, and sesame oil.
Add the mixture to the robata grill and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until fragrant.
Add the flank steak to the grill and cook for 3-4 minutes per side, or until it reaches your desired level of doneness.
Transfer the steak to a cutting board and let it rest for 5 minutes.
In a small pan, heat the rendered beef fat over medium heat.
Add the green onions, ginger, and garlic to the pan and cook for 1-2 minutes, or until fragrant.
Add the toasted sesame seeds and cook for an additional 30 seconds.
Slice the steak against the grain and serve with the sauce and sesame seeds.
Optional: serve with cooked rice for a filling meal.
